title: Questions 158-160 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE: Changes to Residential Loading-Zone Reservations

In order to reduce traffic congestion and manage the cost of street monitoring, the City of Fairhaven is changing to a reservation-based system for temporary loading zones. Residents will no longer be allowed to occupy a curbside space for deliveries or moves without a booking. – [1] –.

Under the revised bylaw, residents must reserve a zone through the city’s Web site or the 211 information line. Every household may claim two free reservations each year, with a maximum of four hours per booking. – [2] –. For any further reservations, a charge of $30 per booking will be applied.

After a reservation is confirmed, residents will be issued a unique permit code. – [3] –. This code must be printed clearly on a card and placed on the vehicle’s dashboard, where it can be seen from outside. – [4] –. Vehicles may not enter the reserved space earlier than 7:00 A.M. on the day of the booking, and ignoring this restriction may lead to a ticket.
